description: The extended INFORMATION_SCHEMA surface: DATABASES/SCHEMATA carry IS_TRANSIENT / LAST_ALTERED / RETENTION_TIME (not RETENTION_TIME_DAYS), TABLES carries owner/type/bytes with YES/NO transient flags, COLUMNS carries NUMERIC_PRECISION and IS_IDENTITY, VIEWS carries owner and options, PROCEDURES and FUNCTIONS report language/signature (table-ness carried by DATA_TYPE 'TABLE (...)' - no IS_TABLE_FUNCTION column), SEQUENCES reports start values, TABLE_CONSTRAINTS / REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS / role and privilege views are queryable, STREAMS/TASKS/TAGS/TAG_REFERENCES are NOT views (does-not-exist, the objects list via SHOW), PIPES reports pipes, and the views are scoped to the current database. Converted 1:1 from features/InformationSchemaExtTest (now retired).

steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) >= 1 FROM (SELECT DATABASE_NAME, IS_TRANSIENT, LAST_ALTERED FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.DATABASES)
SELECT COUNT(*) >= 1 FROM (SELECT SCHEMA_NAME, IS_TRANSIENT, IS_MANAGED_ACCESS, RETENTION_TIME, OWNER_ROLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA)
SELECT COUNT(*) >= 1 FROM (SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_OWNER, TABLE_TYPE, BYTES, LAST_ALTERED FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES)
SELECT IS_TRANSIENT FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'TRANS_T'
CREATE TABLE nums (id INTEGER, val FLOAT)
SELECT COUNT(*) >= 2 FROM (SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, NUMERIC_PRECISION, IS_IDENTITY FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS)
CREATE TABLE auto_t (id INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT, name VARCHAR)
SELECT COUNT(*) >= 2 FROM (SELECT COLUMN_NAME, IS_IDENTITY FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS)
CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT * FROM base
SELECT COUNT(*) >= 1 FROM (SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_OWNER, CHECK_OPTION, IS_UPDATABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS)

CREATE PROCEDURE greet(name VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$
    BEGIN RETURN 'Hello'; END
$$
CREATE FUNCTION add_one(n INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS $$ SELECT 1 $$
CREATE FUNCTION rows_fn() RETURNS TABLE(v VARCHAR) AS $$ SELECT 'a' $$
CREATE TABLE ct (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, val VARCHAR UNIQUE)
SELECT COUNT(*) >= 2 FROM (SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME, CONSTRAINT_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS)
SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME, MATCH_OPTION, UPDATE_RULE, DELETE_RULE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS
SELECT COUNT(*) >= 1 FROM (SELECT ROLE_NAME, ROLE_OWNER FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ENABLED_ROLES)
SELECT GRANTEE, ROLE_NAME, IS_GRANTABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.APPLICABLE_ROLES
SELECT GRANTOR, GRANTEE, TABLE_NAME, PRIVILEGE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_PRIVILEGES
SELECT OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, PRIVILEGE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.OBJECT_PRIVILEGES
CREATE STREAM s1 ON TABLE src
CREATE TABLE load_target (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
CREATE PIPE p1 AS COPY INTO load_target FROM @my_stage
